findings.evidence: A commit joins whatever operation is in progress. During a merge it becomes the merge commit, with two parents and the other branch's changes.
findings.fix: Keep the non-obvious rebase, cherry-pick and revert outcomes; move the merge-commit-has-two-parents sentence to references/ or record the removal, since an agent already knows a commit during a merge is a merge commit.

findings.evidence: Read `references/commit-message-template.md` only when the repository sets its own message rules (commitlint config, commit template, CONTRIBUTING, PR template), you need footers beyond `BREAKING CHANGE`, or you want worked messages and the report block of step 8.
findings.fix: Split the load: read the report-block section of references/commit-message-template.md on every step 8 report, and load the repository-rules, commitlint defaults and spec sections only when the repository sets its own rules or a footer beyond BREAKING CHANGE is needed.

findings.evidence: Verify the staged version with the fastest relevant check: tests for the touched paths, else lint, else build.
findings.fix: Name the default lookup (the repository's test script for the touched paths, else its lint script, else its build script) and say to ask only when none of those exists.

findings.evidence: "id": "review-and-commit" ... "Shows ordered `git status`, `git diff`, `git add -- src/auth.ts`, `git diff --cached`, and `git commit` commands."
findings.fix: Add assertions for a failed git apply --cached --check, a repository with no commits yet (read-tree --empty), and a pre-existing <gitdir>/commit-work.* directory that must be reported and left alone; keep the existing 15 prompts.

findings.evidence: Overlap check, real index, before staging anything: `git diff --cached --name-only -- <approved paths>` lists approved paths that already hold staged content. Any listed path whose staged diff the user did not approve: stop and ask
findings.fix: State the overlap outcome when the user did approve that staged diff: commit that exact staged version, do not restage the working-tree file over it, and do not stop.

Read the installed @commitlint/config-conventional preset (or the cited index.ts) for header-max-length, body-max-line-length and footer-max-line-length instead of hardcoding 100; keep the source URL and the checked date only as the fallback, and note that the preset sets those lengths to Infinity.
